decisions.reason: As a door lever handle family in the firm's core business that survived the initial 2019 pruning, it likely showed sufficient demand and is relatively inexpensive to keep in the range, so continuation is preferred.

This door handle design also survived beyond launch while other 2018 handle variants were removed quickly, suggesting acceptable market reception, although style-driven products carry somewhat higher replacement risk.

The electronic access system is a costlier and more uncertain adjacent-market option, but its continued website presence and upgraded 2019 positioning indicate ongoing strategic interest, so it is worth keeping unless later evidence turns clearly negative.
